Definition: from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5339; unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism):--neglecting.
BiblicalUsage: Unsparingness — Paul naming the show of wisdom in self-made religion: will-worship, humility, and neglecting of the body, all with no honour in them. The word is severity without value, harshness that God never asked for.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe harshness toward the body is not holiness; Christ's yoke is easy, and severity I invent for myself is not devotion.
